svg.title: Historical Hessian PPL comparison
svg.desc: Absolute PPL and PPL minus historical common H at 20, 30, 40 and 50 percent sparsity. Historical and checkpoint reconstruction protocols differ. Missing results are not plotted.
svg.text: Llama-2-7B · C4 64 × 4096 · seed 0 · full WikiText2 · lower PPL is better
ΔPPL = method − historical common H; negative values indicate lower recorded PPL.
Descriptive comparison: historical and checkpoint reconstruction protocols differ; no uncertainty estimates.
Source: docs/RESULTS.md · Missing nonstructured 50% mean results are omitted, not interpolated.
